digest.component_or_area: code review gate + impact scoring (code-v3 to code-v4 migration)
propositions: Code review cannot block test-sufficiency findings under v3 because the impact model discards verifiers' documented prod_impact/trigger_likelihood judgments for maint-lane findings; the fire case is a contract declaring stale>0 allowed paired with a test forbidding stale=0.

The tests binary (reachable_path_without_automated_coverage) scores ~0.30 in v3 due to churn dampener (×0.5 on 80% of corpus) capping priority below advisory@0.95, despite 70/1664 findings having prod_impact=medium/high that hand-review confirms as load-bearing.

v4 must re-scope prod_impact/trigger_likelihood field descriptions to document the guarded-path user-reach keying verifiers already use in practice, add forbids_contract_allowed_state as a serious binary, implement lane-split scaling (serious undamped, moderate prod_impact-keyed, debt churn-amplifier-only), and restrict reversibility floor to consequence lanes only to prevent debt-only+hard_to_reverse findings from false-positive blocking.

Replay on code-v3 corpus (1881 sidecars, 1243 changes) must reproduce 99 blocking changes (8.0%) under v4+tests@0.54 with zero demotions of currently-blocking findings, confirmed via offline analysis without rewriting stored v3 sidecars (version-gated).

Test suite must verify v4 arithmetic (serious-maint undamped; prod_impact damping at low=0.6/none=0.5; churn=0 multiplier exactly 1.0; floor fires consequence-lane-only; HIGH/NIT median separation >0.30 and NIT<0.30 over labels fixture under v4) and integration-test the fire case end-to-end to BLOCK.

Eight consumer sites require version/blocking-set pins: test_impact_model_versioning.py (2 equality sites + pin), test_code_review_ws2.py (pin), plus test_impact_code.py premise rewrites (delete test_new_binary_scales_with_churn, re-target freq_mult pair to debt, invert reversibility-floor case, update cold-debt 0.12→0.24 and eval specs).
